title: Omnipresent ⌘K AI Career Copilot & Universal Command Surface 10/10 Overhaul (Context-Aware Prompts, Quick Actions & Multi-Model Execution)
spec:
# DIR-021: Omnipresent ⌘K AI Career Copilot & Universal Command Surface 10/10 Overhaul

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives (Opportunity Fix)
The Cuba Command Palette (`src/components/cuba/CubaCommandPalette.jsx`) is currently a basic navigation search bar. While it can jump to routes, it does not leverage the platform's dynamic multi-model AI routing engine (DIR-013, DIR-014) to provide an interactive, context-aware AI assistant.

This directive mandates a 10/10 transformation of the Cuba Command Palette into a unified **AI Career Copilot & Command Surface**, inspired by Linear/Raycast/Superhuman, available across all 4 dashboards (Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, Admin) with instant prompt execution, context-aware quick actions, and dedicated Playwright E2E verification.

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Dual-Mode Command Surface (Navigation + AI Copilot)**:
   - Provide a seamless mode switcher at the top of the palette:
     - `Navigation (Tab / Slash)`: Instant fuzzy search across all portal routes, settings tabs, resume documents, and jobs.
     - `AI Copilot (Tab / Space)`: Natural language prompt input with AI action chips.
   - Global keyboard trigger: `Ctrl+K` (Windows/Linux) / `Cmd+K` (macOS).

2. **Context-Aware Action Chips**:
   - Dynamically adapt suggested action pills based on the user's active portal and current route:
     - Candidate on `/dashboard`: "⚡ Optimize resume for ATS", "✍️ Generate cover letter for target role", "🎙️ Start mock interview practice".
     - Candidate on `/build-resume`: "🪄 Polish active step descriptions", "🎯 Add quantifiable metric bullet points".
     - Recruiter on `/employer/pipeline`: "📊 Summarize candidate pool", "✉️ Draft interview invite email".
     - Admin on `/admin`: "🔍 Search user or tenant", "🛡️ View recent security audit logs".

3. **In-Palette Result Card & 1-Click Application**:
   - When an AI prompt is submitted, display a smooth progress indicator with rotating tips.
   - Render the formatted response in an elevated Cuba card inside the palette viewport.
   - Provide quick action buttons: "Copy to Clipboard", "Insert into Editor", "Open in Full Screen".

4. **Dedicated Playwright E2E Verification**:
   - Author `playwright.dir021.config.js` targeting `tests/e2e/dir021-command-copilot.spec.js`.
   - Test Ctrl+K hotkey, mode switching, fuzzy query ranking, AI prompt simulation, and Escape-key dismiss against the live dev server without mocks.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).
INV-2: Zero Prompt / Token Leakage: AI prompts, tokens, and candidate PII must not be leaked into browser URL queries, localStorage logs, or public telemetry.
INV-3: Quota & Rate Limit Gating: Command palette AI requests must strictly consume the user's authenticated MariaDB daily AI quota and fail-closed when quota is exhausted.
INV-4: WCAG 2.1 AA Contrast: Palette surface, input, badges, and highlighted search match text must exceed 4.5:1 contrast in both light and dark themes.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Sub-50ms keystroke filter response; palette mount latency < 100ms.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Universal Command Palette Upgrade: Elevate CubaCommandPalette.jsx across all 4 portals (Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, Admin) with two distinct modes: (1) Navigation Mode (jump to any tab, setting, or document with fuzzy ranking) and (2) AI Copilot Mode (prompt-driven career actions).

AC-2: Context-Aware AI Quick Prompts: When opened in Candidate portal, surface context-aware shortcuts: 'Tailor resume to job description', 'Generate cover letter', 'Start mock interview session', 'Audit resume for ATS keywords'; in Recruiter portal: 'Screen top 5 applicants', 'Generate interview scorecard', 'Draft outreach message'; in Enterprise: 'Summarize tenant quota usage'.

AC-3: In-Palette Real-Time AI Generation: Enable user to enter a natural language prompt directly in ⌘K, dispatching to backend aiService with live streaming or progress spinner, rendering the generated result directly in an in-palette preview card with 1-click 'Apply to Resume' or 'Copy'.

AC-4: Keyboard Accessibility & Zero-Mouse Navigation: 100% keyboard operable (Ctrl+K / ⌘K toggle, Arrow keys to navigate, Tab to switch modes, Enter to execute, Escape to dismiss) with aria-expanded and aria-activedescendant.

AC-5: Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir021.config.js & tests/e2e/dir021-command-copilot.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server verifying Ctrl+K open/close, mode switching, fuzzy query filtering, AI prompt dispatch, and error recovery.
AC-6: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

plan.summary: DIR-021 RECOVERY: recon complete, ZERO prior DIR-021 artifacts on disk (directive was ISSUED but never implemented; nothing to preserve). INV-1 VERIFIED diff=0 bytes vs e314f715. Live stack UP (API :8080 health=200 authoritativeDatabase=MARIADB; Vite :3000=200). Plan: (1) new pure module src/components/cuba/copilotActions.js holding the context-aware AI quick-action registry keyed by portal+pathname, kept OUT of CubaCommandPalette.jsx so the certified 'exposes only real caller-supplied commands' guard (no hardcoded label:) still passes; (2) new pure module src/components/cuba/copilotPrompt.js mapping free-text prompt + route context onto the REAL ALLOWED_ENDPOINTS operations already enforced by aiService.buildAiRequest (generate-summary/enhance-single-bullet/generate-ai-cover-letter/check-grammar/generate-interview), never inventing an endpoint; (3) rewrite CubaCommandPalette.jsx to a dual-mode surface (Navigation | AI Copilot) with a role=tablist switcher, Tab/Slash and Tab/Space keys, context chips, progress indicator with rotating tips, and an in-palette result card offering Copy / Apply / Open. INV-2: copilot POSTs through existing generateUserAiContent (authenticated, same-origin, server-side prompt construction) - no prompt ever enters a URL query, localStorage or console. INV-3: quota is NOT reimplemented client-side; the real MariaDB counter lives in backend/routes/ai.js executeContentOperation and the palette renders the server 429 AI_DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED verbatim, failing closed. INV-4: only existing AA-proven Cuba semantic tokens (cuba-ink-subtle measures 4.97:1 light / 7.49:1 dark per DIR-017). INV-5: reuse existing memoized rankCommands; no new filtering pass. Backwards-compatible: palette remains a pure navigation surface when no copilotProps are supplied, so DIR-012/DIR-011/DIR-008 E2E suites stay green. Then author playwright.dir021.config.js + tests/e2e/dir021-command-copilot.spec.js against the live stack, plus tests/copilot-command-surface.test.mjs, and run lint/build/test gates.
